method: All IndexedDB requests, result values, transactions, write operations and actual completion events remain native Chromium operations. No fake database or synthetic success value.

Absent-head case seeds real legacy bytes, withholds delivery of actual library get/getKey onsuccess callbacks until native readonly transactioncomplete, then delivers the original event and captured callback. Verifies safe rejection, no thrown callback/pageerror, retained old bytes and no fabricated head/rows.

Deadline-branch case wraps performance.now with a +10001 ms offset immediately inside an observer of genuine native RW transactioncomplete before delivering its original oncomplete callback. Native 10000 ms timer has not fired. This is injected monotonic time, not a second actual 10-second wall-clock timeout.

The native write already committed in the injected deadline branch. Independent subsequent native database reads prove its actual row remains; old opaque receipts cannot remove protection, and fresh accepted read/project permits a new successful save.
Different-row case reads and accepts refreshed catalog after foreign selection, explicitly duplicates local accepted A into C, and compares A/B/C saved payloads independently.
Cross-client delete review refuses unaccepted changed catalog, leaves exact rows/pointer, then compatible fresh acceptance allows deliberate nonactive deletion preserving foreign-selected B.
